title: Bangkok itinerary (6 days, 2026 prices)
summary: Marcos' 6-day Bangkok/Thailand itinerary with 2026 prices in Thai baht. Day 1 (Bangkok Old City): Wat Arun, Grand Palace, Wat Pho Reclining Buddha, Museum Siam, sunset Wat Arun view, Wat Pho Pier + Soi Tha Suphan, Tyme Rooftop, ICONSIAM. Day 2 (Siam, Mahanakhon & river cruise): Pratunam Market, Platinum Mall, LV Cafe, Siam Paragon, Gourmet Eats, Bangkok Art & Culture Centre / Jim Thompson House, Mahanakhon Skywalk, Chao Phraya River Cruise at sunset. Day 3 (Ancient City + Chinatown). Day 4 (Pattaya day tour). Day 5 (Ayutthaya day tour). Day 6 (floating + train market).

title: Athens 2026: 3-Day Guide

items.name: History and chill
items.details: National Archaeological Museum; Guard Change at Syntagma; National Garden; columns of Olympian Zeus; run a lap at the Panathenaic Stadium; Acropolis Museum 2nd-floor restaurant for Parthenon views
